name: Gomi Mitai na Otona
source:
I want to die.

As I go on living...

I don't know

how to.

But then again... I suppose I am alive.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240228203721/https://ahito.com/game/boyslove/big/gomimitaina/]official website[/url]]
